candidate.rule_context: Public Records Compliance Note: All public records requests received by the City of Meridian are subject to the statutory response timeline of ten business days for an initial determination. This deadline applies to every request regardless of volume, complexity, or staffing. A request may not be closed, denied, or marked resolved on the basis of workload, backlog, or inability to locate records within the initial window. The only permissible actions within the statutory period are: (1) providing the responsive records, (2) issuing a written acknowledgment that includes a specific extension of up to ten additional business days as allowed by law, or (3) issuing a written denial citing a specific statutory exemption. Any workflow that terminates a request without one of these three documented outcomes is non-compliant and exposes the city to legal liability. The queue-clearing metric does not override this requirement.
